mapper.insert: INSERT INTO visit_logs (visited_on, visitor_key, path, device) VALUES (#{day}, #{visitorKey}, #{path}, #{device})
INSERT INTO post_view_logs (post_type, post_id, viewed_on, visitor_key) VALUES (#{type}, #{postId}, #{day}, #{visitorKey})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ${table} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_key) FROM visit_logs WHERE visited_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit_logs WHERE visited_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_view_logs WHERE viewed_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.visitors), 0) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_key) AS visitors FROM visit_logs GROUP BY visited_on) d
SELECT visited_on AS stat_day, COUNT(DISTINCT visitor_key) AS visitors, COUNT(*) AS page_views FROM visit_logs WHERE visited_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY visited_on ORDER BY visited_on
SELECT viewed_on AS stat_day, COUNT(*) AS post_views FROM post_view_logs WHERE viewed_on BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY viewed_on ORDER BY viewed_on
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM post_view_logs WHERE post_type = #{type} AND post_id = #{postId}
mapper.update: UPDATE post_view_logs SET post_type = #{toType}, post_id = #{toId} WHERE post_type = #{fromType} AND post_id = #{fromId}
